audited_denies.title: Seeding Plates with Mammalian Cells
audited_denies.explanation: Dispenses cell suspension from `.top()` (non-contact air dispense) above pre-wetted plate wells and reuses tips back into the cell reservoir; `REHEARSAL` models all `xfer` dispenses as meniscus-contacting.

audited_denies.title: plexWell LP384 Part 1
audited_denies.explanation: Adds 6.0 uL buffer to `Destination 1` (`biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr[A1]`) containing undeclared pre-plated sample DNA (API v2.0) and mixes 6.0 uL; without `load_liquid`, inferred volume `6.0 uL` fails `deadVol (5.0 uL) + 6.0 <= 6.0`.

audited_denies.title: Pooling and Normalization via CSV
audited_denies.explanation: Routes a 10.5 uL sample transfer (`xfer 2 -> 3, 105 tenths`) through `p300_single_gen2` (20.0-200.0 uL filter-tip range), violating the 20.0 uL minimum calibrated P300 volume.

audited_denies.title: droplet digital PCR Prep
audited_denies.explanation: Aspirates 180.0 uL followed by 160.0 uL (340.0 uL total) from a single `biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr[A8]` well whose physical capacity is only 200.0 uL (impossible without undocumented mid-run refill).

audited_denies.title: Copy Number Variant (CNV) Plating
audited_denies.explanation: Aspirates 3 x 10.0 uL = 30.0 uL per channel from `microampoptical_384_wellplate_30ul[A1]` (30.0 uL brim capacity), leaving zero dead-volume reserve in a 384-well optical plate.

audited_denies.title: Custom Cherrypicking
audited_denies.explanation: Default example CSV includes a same-well `B2 -> B2` (6.0 uL) entry that lowers to `xfer(5, 5, 60)`; `REHEARSAL` enforces `src != dst` (`distinct_transfer_wells`) rather than treating same-well aspirate+dispense as a 1-stroke mix.

audited_denies.title: RNA Normalization I & II
audited_denies.explanation: Adds 50.0 uL diluent to a 1.5 mL tube holding undeclared starting RNA stock (API v2.11) and mixes 50.0 uL; without `load_liquid`, inferred volume `50.0 uL` fails `deadVol (5.0 uL) + 50.0 <= 50.0`.

audited_denies.title: Seed Cells [2/7]
audited_denies.explanation: Dispenses 250.0 uL per channel into `spl_96_wellplate_200ul_round[A1]` whose labware definition specifies a 200.0 uL maximum well capacity (+50.0 uL overfill missed by legacy Opentrons simulation).

audited_denies.title: PCR Prep
audited_denies.explanation: Draws 4 x 5.0 uL = 20.0 uL out of `genmate_96_aluminumblock_20ul[A1]` (20.0 uL brim capacity), leaving 0.0 uL dead-volume margin and aspirating air on the final replicate.

audited_denies.title: Sample Transfer to 96 Well-Plate
audited_denies.explanation: Default `vol_dispensed` transfers 200.0 uL from a 6x4 tube rack into `microamp_96_wellplate_100ul[A1]` whose maximum capacity is 100.0 uL (2.0x well overfill).

audited_denies.title: Serial Dilution for Eskil
audited_denies.explanation: Attempts to aspirate 100.0 uL in a single stroke from `opentrons_96_aluminumblock_nest_wellplate_100ul[A1]` (100.0 uL max capacity), exhausting 100% of brim volume with zero dead-volume reserve.

audited_denies.title: Titration Procedure
audited_denies.explanation: Adds 2,000.0 uL titrant into `custom_beaker[A1]` and withdraws 2,000.0 uL; because API v2.x pre-2.14 lacks `Well.load_liquid` to declare the initial titrand already in the beaker, `REHEARSAL` infers `init_vol = 0` and flags a 5.0 uL dead-volume deficit.

audited_denies.title: Normalization
audited_denies.explanation: Splits a 67.0 uL sample normalization transfer (`33.5 + 33.5 uL` on `p50_single`) with `mix_after=(3, 50)` inside diluted well `B1` and re-enters concentrated sample stock `C1` with the same diluted tip.

audited_denies.title: High-Throughput Synthesis
audited_denies.explanation: Cumulative multi-reagent transfers into `opentrons_24_tuberack_nest_2ml_screwcap[A1]` (2,000.0 uL max capacity) exceed 2.0 mL on step 61 (+270.0 uL dispense causes tube overflow).

audited_denies.title: Standard Curve Dilutions with CSV File
audited_denies.explanation: Pre-wets the `p50_single` tip in stock tube `B1` via explicit `aspirate(20.8) + dispense(20.8)` in `B1` before transferring; `REHEARSAL` rejects `src == dst` unless written as `pip.mix()`.

audited_denies.title: Sample Prep with Custom Labware
audited_denies.explanation: Splits an 80.0 uL transfer (`40.0 + 40.0 uL` on `p50_single`) from mixed intermediate tube `A1` into empty tube `A2`; integer floor division `(soluteAmt * v) // vol` rounds down by 1 unit on stroke 1, tripping strict concentration monotonicity on stroke 2.

audited_denies.title: CYP Induction, Part 2/3
audited_denies.explanation: `p20_multi_gen2.distribute()` returns 2.0 uL residual `disposal_volume` back into `nest_1_reservoir_195ml[A1]` via `dispense(2.0, rt_mix)`, which lowers to `xfer(49, 49, 20)` and trips `distinct_transfer_wells`.

audited_denies.title: Apostle Prot. K
audited_denies.explanation: Uses a `p50_multi` pipette (calibrated range 5.0-50.0 uL) to aspirate 4.0 uL of Proteinase K from `aspir8_1_reservoir_taped[A1]`, below the 5.0 uL minimum volume specification.

audited_denies.title: Custom CSV Transfer
audited_denies.explanation: Transfers 30.0 uL into `corning_96_wellplate_360ul_flat[A1]` (pre-filled assay plate undeclared in API v2.8) and mixes 30.0 uL x 10 reps; inferred `30.0 uL` fails `deadVol (5.0 uL) + 30.0 <= 30.0`.

audited_denies.title: Anti-CD154 Labeling of Peptide- and PMA-Stimulated Cells
audited_denies.explanation: Performs a manual 1-stroke `aspirate(20.0) + dispense(20.0)` mix in `nest_96_wellplate_320ul[A1]` after reagent addition instead of calling `pip.mix()`, tripping `distinct_transfer_wells`.

audited_denies.title: Cherrypicking with multi-channel pipette substituting for a single channel pipette
audited_denies.explanation: Default parameter bundle pairs `p300_multi_gen2` (calibrated minimum 20.0 uL) with a 1.0 uL CSV transfer on step 1, operating 20x below the pipette's minimum calibrated volume.

audited_denies.title: PCB Board Plating
audited_denies.explanation: Transfers 10.0 uL of tetrahydrofuran twice into custom `pcb_board_250_wells[A1]`, whose custom labware definition declares a 2.0 uL micro-cavity capacity (5x single-dispense overfill).

audited_denies.title: Cherrypicking and Normalization
audited_denies.explanation: Dispenses 5.0 uL into `nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt[A11]` (undeclared pre-staged diluent, plus conservative 5.0 uL default `deadVol` on a 100 uL PCR well) and mixes 5.0 uL x 3 reps.
